scope: Actual PNG visual design families; separate from historical Java-method ledger227
policy: One atlas/set/frame sequence/recolor family is at most one unit. Cross-task prior semantic dedup still pending. No automatic global ledger credit.

rows.observation_zh: 四个凹尖围出空心中心，外圈小圆与十字分层；中心留白优于整面发亮。只借主次与负空间，不照抄花边。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四个相交大瓣各容一个小符号，中心交界留黑；元素身份靠不同内符而非只靠颜色。四瓣关系不作四个参考。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四个方结组成内方阵，外框四角内凹；适合研究方印的中轴和角点。外部碎点须减量，不能复制成敕字。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 正方形与菱形叠置，中央完全留空，外圈断续小点；护体边界与中心内容分离。该符不证明尚方剑已有接入。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四个三角内指、四圆占四向，斜角小三角作次级节奏；可学方向感，不用密线冒充雷符。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 凹边四角和两条交叉弧线围成中心菱形，外缘仅八处小点；比整圈均布纹样有疏密。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四向尖角与斜向方框交替，双细环内侧留白；身份来自节点节奏。与pactum/repel保守合为一族，不能按配色拆计。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 八个同心小圆落在双圈外缘，中心无图；节点圆和外轮廓圆重复较强，只用于边界排布研究，不作独特流派最终稿。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 128×256上下两帧是同一小方环链；帧色不同不拆计。与pure同属小方链边框，保守合并。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四个较大的内向月牙决定轮廓，斜向圆较小；主符号有尺度差。只借星月类主次，不把月牙直接当逐星专属。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四向大三角、斜向叠方和小菱点；比absolute复杂，但相同八节点交替组织，本批不重复记一族。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 一圈方孔与小菱点相间、双线限宽；与corrupt环链属于同族，不靠白色换色新增参考。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 八向三角尖围双环，中心空；与absolute/pactum同为尖节点双环边框，本批合并，不按红紫金拆计。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 四向椭圆主结、斜向小方结配内卷钩，空白中心占绝大部分；借大结/小结层次，拒绝照搬眼形与旋纹。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 白色碎符外圈内是宽幅模糊光团。违反用户硬边材质方向，作为反例保留，不计有效设计参考。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 粉色板片以深色接缝划分，亮点集中于凸缘，留大块实底；与蓝色manasteel共用板片组织，本批合一族。64×128不是原版64×32，未推断具体身体面。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 蓝钢面用短硬高光、暗接缝而非周身白描边；与elementium同族，仅比较材质明度，不加一条。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 青色细竖褶与横边分工、下方大片深布压住亮上部；布料节奏不同于金属接缝。不直接套成竹节或龙鳞。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 亮绿板片间穿插棕绑带、少数暗槽；材质在连接处换色，避免全套一色。没有按每条绑带计数。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 大面积炭黑布仅用短低对比折线，金边落在开襟与下缘、腰扣集中；不是全表面铺金纹。图集96×96，需原模型才能认定正背UV。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 骨色冠齿、深红小面与细长条同图；PNG里可见材质但不能确认细条对应骨冠哪一面。待匹配模型后再判独立性，不计数。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 三条棕皮展开面、交叉白绑带、金色鞋口线；同一双靴的多面不是三件参考。交叉绑带需配合几何确认朝向。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 浅冰白不规则硬边岛压在深青底衣上，白点与深槽不等密；上浅下深保持读图。未称其已在本项目穿戴。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 暗红布、黑裙和骨色齿状边形成材质层；金扣为孤立强调，避免骨色和布色平均铺满。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 蓝灰大布面、淡铜边线、方形中心块；暗色水平断续折线较克制。只借蓝灰/铜色面积关系。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 金冠仅一条细横面，无法仅从PNG确认金齿轮廓和受光方向；与另两条冠材质暂不拆成独立设计。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 黑色块状表面与金色开窗带交替，棕色交接块说明边带层次；金色集中在局部结构，不能推成全金甲。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 深紫板面与淡紫大片硬边纹理分区，细线面单独排；浅色斑纹与wizard织物方向相近，本批保守合并，避免把UV重排算新设计。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 金白甲片与棋盘链甲区域明确分离，最亮色只在大斜面和角部；链甲不应平铺整个胸甲。64×64图集，不能按其他96图强行映射。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 墨绿布和暗紫围带衬出骨黄小区域，孤立青色扣点；材质重心集中。骨区只靠PNG不能断定正脸对应。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 乳白大面加低对比浅灰折痕，紫金只占横带和局部；亮衣不靠整面纯白填充，适合研究神圣感而非照搬宗教符号。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 黑色布为主体，暗红跨面、金色扣口是小亮点，袖/下缘窄灰色磨损；火系不需要把全身画成火焰。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 大块暗灰斜条与稀疏银链/扣分开，紫色占较少肩/布区域；细亮链可以局部用，不把全套描成白框。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 淡灰紫冠条与gold_crown类似展开，仅颜色不足以算独立造型；待模型绑定，不计数。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 蓝布的大折痕、金色衣边和棕色袋带分工，绿色下摆只作局部；功能材质在连接处出现，避免所有布面同密度花纹。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 淡紫/乳白的块状织纹、棕色细带、下方两个大圆岛；圆岛的模型作用不猜测。与netherite同类浅斑纹组织保守合并。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 32px粗线八向结与中心小星仍有可读性；外围半透明光晕不采用，只研究主线/孔洞关系。不能把柔光样式原封移植。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 中央单火苗、矩形角与外圈相接，红橙深浅分层；中央图标和外框各有职责，边缘柔光不借鉴。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 粗环由斜向交错菱结组成，中心透明；与frost/lightning的结点安排相同，仅色与亮度差别，三张合一族。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 青白同心编结环，与fire_sigil同形，换色不新增设计参考；不因法术名不同拆计。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 同样的青白编结环，火/霜/雷不能用三种名称当三种独立纹样；本批与39合并。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 256px大幅平滑径向色带和柔光，完全不符合本轮硬边MC纹样标准；只作为明确反例，不计数。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 橙红直角格线中留四大孔与若干小方孔，32px硬边可读；纹样由连通关系决定，不需要曲线或光晕。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 16px四向叉枝围中心方孔，端点向角分叉，整体较粗；研究留孔和主干宽度，不复制该召唤符。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 128×64大透明图集上仅少量金色短符列，尚未定位对应兽体面。缺少面向证据前不计独立护体纹样。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 紫色方形套框、中心小方孔、下方独立挂结，方向性明确；相较对称圆环可研究符首/符尾的主次。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.

rows.observation_zh: 青色八边同心环，当前只见通用圈层，未发现超出现有环类的目标专属用途；不为凑数新增一族。
rows.limitation: PNG composition/material inspection only; no face assignment, game, animation, emissive shader or runtime claimed.
